title: Scaffold idempotency tests for replay scenarios
description: Draft comprehensive test scaffolds for ensuring Wheelwright operations are idempotent and concurrency-safe. Covers replaying same closeout twice, concurrent closeouts on one spoke, duplicate signal publication, and interrupted migration replay scenarios.

test_categories.closeout_replay: 7 test methods ensuring second closeout detects completion and skips
test_categories.concurrent_closeout: 8 test methods for file locking/serialization with multiple agents
test_categories.signal_deduplication: 9 test methods preventing duplicate signal publication
test_categories.migration_resume: 10 test methods for checkpoint-based resume from interruption

test_infrastructure.spoke_factory: Creates realistic test spokes/hubs with configurable states
test_infrastructure.assertions: Custom WAI state validation and deep comparison tools
test_infrastructure.concurrency_helper: Multi-process coordination and race condition testing

expected_behaviors.closeout_replay: First completes, second detects and skips gracefully
expected_behaviors.concurrent_closeouts: File locking prevents corruption, single winner emerges
expected_behaviors.signal_deduplication: Dedup at source, transport, and destination levels
expected_behaviors.migration_resume: Resume from checkpoint, don't restart from beginning
